description: ESP32-S3 BLE raw HCI AT transcript capture plan. It records the byte-exact controller transport sequence needed by the RA4M1 ArduinoBLE adapter without exposing application data or BLE identities.

cases.summary: Start the ESP32-S3 HCI transport, send one H4 Reset command, capture wait/available/read framing, then stop the transport.
preconditions: UNO R4 WiFi is running the ESP32-S3 baseline bridge firmware.
RA4M1 is already running examples/ra4-at-transcript-proxy at 115200 baud.
The preflight firmware response must identify the expected ESP32-S3 baseline.
This sequence contains no BLE advertising, scanning, connection, pairing, key, or user payload.
The capture sequence must reach hci_end; if it is interrupted, manually send AT+HCIEND followed by CRLF through the proxy before another BLE capture.

operator_actions: If hci_end did not complete, manually send AT+HCIEND followed by CRLF through the proxy before running another BLE capture.
Do not infer controller state from a timed-out exchange; record and investigate the raw transcript first.

cases.summary: Stop the controller left active by the RA4M1 ArduinoBLE wait smoke before a separate timing capture.
preconditions: UNO R4 WiFi is running the ESP32-S3 baseline bridge firmware.
RA4M1 is already running examples/ra4-at-transcript-proxy at 115200 baud.
The preceding RA4M1 ArduinoBLE wait smoke may have initialized the ESP32-S3 raw HCI controller because its ArduinoBLE transport end() implementation is empty.
The preflight firmware response must identify the expected ESP32-S3 baseline.
This sequence does not scan, advertise, connect, pair, read BLE identities, or send HCI payload data.

operator_actions: Proceed to hci_wait_250_round_trip only when this HCIEND capture reached a terminal response.
If it times out, do not infer controller state or issue HCIBEGIN; record and investigate the raw result first.

cases.summary: From a known stopped controller, measure HCIWAIT=250 and the following HCIAVAILABLE response without an HCI payload.
preconditions: UNO R4 WiFi is running the ESP32-S3 baseline bridge firmware.
RA4M1 is already running examples/ra4-at-transcript-proxy at 115200 baud.
The immediately preceding hci_end_after_ra4_wait_smoke capture reached a terminal response on the same board.
The preflight firmware response must identify the expected ESP32-S3 baseline.
This sequence contains no BLE advertising, scanning, connection, pairing, identity read, key, or application payload.

operator_actions: If hci_end did not complete, manually send AT+HCIEND followed by CRLF through the proxy before another BLE capture.
Treat a timeout or stale bytes before a step as capture evidence; do not retry HCIBEGIN until controller state is re-established.
